title: Fenceline event
description: One observed action by an AI agent, with what the agent reported (said) and what the OS observed (seen). One JSON object per line.

ts.description: When it happened, ISO 8601 with offset.

agent.description: Which agent. Canonical values are claude-code and copilot.

zone.description: fence = inside the workspace, net = network, tools = a CLI tool, vault = anywhere else on the machine.

target.description: Path, URL, host or tool name.

said.description: What the agent reported. null (or omitted) means the agent did not report it.

seen.description: What the OS observed. One or more observations.

verdict.description: Optional. If omitted, Fenceline decides: unreported outside the workspace is a breach; elsewhere on the machine is a warning.

rule.description: Why the verdict was given, shown under the row.

workspace.description: Label for the fenced workspace, e.g. ~/code/payments-api.

source.description: Short label such as hook, otel, es or net.
